starting_stack_raw_support.broadcast_overlay: Best of 5; 0–0; FINALS; 400/800; Ivey 99.2K after posting 800; Antonius 99.6K after posting 400; pot 1,200.
starting_stack_raw_support.initial_stack_arithmetic: The official match-start amount is 100,000 each. The first hand overlay independently agrees after subtracting the visible posts: Ivey 100,000−800=99,200 and Antonius 100,000−400=99,600.
starting_stack_raw_support.official_wpt_day1_structure_summary: The official update specifies a 100,000-chip match start, 400/800 opening blinds, seven-hand levels, and a best-of-five final.
starting_stack_raw_support.official_wpt_day2_structure_summary: The official Day 2 update corroborates the 100,000 start, 400/800 first level, and seven-hand level interval.

match.starting_stack_classification: 100,000 each is an explicitly stated official match-start amount and is the exact start for this first game; subsequent exact stacks are arithmetic derivations from source-checked actions and forced bets. No reset policy is inferred for later games.

ante.basis: Each hand has its own forced_bets_at_opening evidence: the settled displayed pot equals the displayed small and big blinds. The official structure announcements do not specify ante policy.

straddle.basis: Each hand has its own forced_bets_at_opening evidence: the settled displayed pot equals the displayed small and big blinds, with no additional forced wager visible. The official structure announcements do not specify straddle policy.

blind_progression_crosscheck.official_rule: Blinds start at 400/800 and levels go up after every seven hands.
blind_progression_crosscheck.broadcast_observation: The broadcast overlay shows 400/800 through review contexts H01–H11 and 500/1,000 at H12–H20.
blind_progression_crosscheck.unresolved_discrepancy: If H01 is treated as hand one of the first game, the visible transition after H11 does not match the seven-hand structure statement. The sampled chronology shows no missing hand or cut in this interval. Records preserve per-hand broadcast blinds and do not infer unseen hands or a different counter boundary.

interruptions_and_missing_information.sampled_chronology_note: The 2-second timeline shows consecutive hand/action flow; no interruption, source cut, or missing hand context was detected. Sub-2-second transitions may be invisible at this sampling resolution. Brief pot-overlay animation values are logged separately and settled values are used.
interruptions_and_missing_information.opponent_hole_cards: Intentionally omitted from structured observations and evidence images.
interruptions_and_missing_information.equity_overlays: Intentionally omitted from structured observations and evidence images.
interruptions_and_missing_information.out_of_window: Hand 20 remains pending after Ivey raises to 2,500 at 00:55:22; Antonius response and outcome are outside the frozen window.

H20 settled opening pot was 1,500 at the predecision frame 00:55:20.
